testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.ai.MultiProviderTests

testcase.name: an explicit model is never replaced, auto never reaches a paid provider, a local model gets no key()
models of other providers stay disabled until a system admin enables them, unconfigured providers are refused()
Anthropic - x-api-key and version headers, separate system prompt, input and cached tokens counted, a rejected key is fatal and nothing leaks()
admin provider list shows configuration without secrets, the connection check is live()
an enabled OpenAI-compatible model gets the key only in the header, usage is recorded, cost comes from the pricing catalog()
